_doc: Culinary-to-Federal crosswalk: Cost Index ingredient slugs -> US Census HS6 import commodity codes. Every code is VERIFIED against the Census I_COMMODITY_SDESC returned in data/census-imports.jsonl (the description must match the ingredient). US Census general-imports data is public domain. HS6 is the finest public aggregation; some codes combine related items or a single form (fresh/frozen) — noted. This is a descriptive reference of the US import stream — never a delivered/retail price, never import VOLUME (quantity is not published at HS6), never a forecast.
_source: US Census Bureau, International Trade, general imports by HS6 (api.census.gov/data/timeseries/intltrade/imports/hs). Public domain.

080550.sdesc: LEMONS AND LIMES, FRESH OR DRIED
080550.note: HS6 combines lemons and limes; not split at 6 digits.

080540.sdesc: GRAPEFRUIT AND POMELOS, FRESH OR DRIED

081040.note: HS6 combines cranberries, blueberries and related Vaccinium berries; the value is the group, broader than blueberries alone.

081020.note: HS6 combines raspberries, blackberries, mulberries and loganberries; broader than raspberries alone.

070960.sdesc: FRUITS OF GENUS CAPSICUM OR PIMENTA, FRESH
070960.note: HS6 covers all fresh Capsicum peppers; not split by variety.

070700.sdesc: CUCUMBERS AND GHERKINS, FRESH OR CHILLED

030617.note: Frozen shrimp/prawns (the dominant import form); fresh shrimp is a separate code.

030441.note: Fresh salmon fillets; whole salmon is a separate code.

030487.note: Frozen tuna (Thunnus + skipjack), the dominant import form; fresh tuna is separate codes.

030614.note: Frozen crab (the dominant import form); fresh/live crab is a separate code.

030612.note: Frozen lobster; fresh/live lobster is a separate code.

030729.note: Scallops not elsewhere specified; some scallop trade sits under other codes.

030759.sdesc: OCTOPUS, FROZEN, DRIED, SALTED OR IN BRINE

030743.note: Frozen squid; HS6 present from 2017 (earlier years under prior codes).

030779.sdesc: CLAMS, COCKLES AND ARK SHELLS, NESOI
030779.note: Clams, cockles and ark shells combined (NESOI).
